mandate: TO: CLAUDE DEVELOPER -- Production bug: legal/tax/receipt edits in Merchant Settings silently failed to persist

base.description: origin/main at the start of this lot (merge of PR #125, CGV W2 publication boundary fixes)

rootCause: submit() unconditionally re-validates and re-mutates ~11 sections on EVERY save click, regardless of which fields the merchant actually touched, and updateReceiptSettings (legal/tax) was the LAST mutating RPC -- the failure of ANY earlier mutation (public contact/WhatsApp, restaurant settings, tracking status text, colors, maps URL, identity, bg color, social links, languages), even one wholly unrelated to what the merchant edited, silently prevented updateReceiptSettings from ever being called. Mutation ORDERING, not validation ordering, stale state, or a permission failure.
remediation: updateReceiptSettings moved to be the FIRST mutating RPC in submit(), in both full and operator-only modes. No validation moved, no guard weakened (legalProfileReady / legalProfileLoadedRestaurantId guard stays the absolute first instruction, unchanged). Each section still aborts the rest of the submission on its own failure -- atomicity preserved, only the call ORDER changed. Also fixed a raw-server-error leak in the contact/WhatsApp catch block (was surfacing e.message straight from a PostgREST throw) with a new dedicated stContactSaveError i18n key (fr/en/ar), matching the pattern already used by every other section's catch block.
